content: Similar to monolingual evaluation in §SECREF7, we now evaluate several state-of-the-art cross-lingual representation models on the suite of 66 automatically constructed cross-lingual Multi-SimLex datasets. Again, note that evaluating a full range of cross-lingual models available in the rich prior work on cross-lingual representation learning is well beyond the scope of this article. We therefore focus our cross-lingual analyses on several well-established and indicative state-of-the-art cross-lingual models, again spanning both static and contextualized cross-lingual word embeddings.
